avatar.rule: brief 069 (Latch, briefs/069/latch/leftfoot.md): every clip imports with Copy From Other Avatar from one shared reference avatar, so no clip's own frame 0 becomes its muscle zero. The reference is this clip's own Unity avatar (tools/figures/avatar.py, Unity's MakePoseValid) with neutral legs: each leg straight down, Foot->ToeBase along the hips' facing footPitchDeg down (the library's planted flat-foot pitch), the toe level; arms as Unity's T-pose. A clip that can't copy it only because its file has a lone root above the same bones (the clips authored in Blender, under `Armature`) gets its own avatar holding the same rest by bone name (tools/figures/avatar.py reference_rest), with Preserve Hierarchy on: one zero for every clip, never a clip's own frame 0.

relaxedHand.rule: brief 069 (Sky, 2026-10-27: 'hands pose looks unnatural'): clips.py measures each clip's finger bend (fingerBendDeg in clips.rows.json: the two bends inside each finger, index to little, both hands, the clip's mean); one below this share of the reference walk's has flat fingers (fingersFlat). The game plays hand_relaxed on a finger-masked override layer over those clips (and always over a figure's rigid hand, which has no finger bones: a no-op there, its mesh carries the relaxed curl, fit.json transfer.fingers.rigidRelax).

targets.note: brief 069 (Aster, 2026-10-27: install only what the game uses, decided by data). A build of the clip stage is for one target (clips.py <spec> <out> [target]; run.ts builds 'game'). game: the clips without `game: false` reach the game's manifest and controller; the others (the pistol and rifle sets, hand_relaxed) are built beside them but stay out until weapons enter the game. fingerLimits: whether the clip avatars carry tools/figures/finger_limits.json; off for the game until finger-boned new-pipeline figures enter it (today's game figures have Unity's default limits, and both sides must match). pipeline: every clip, with the limits, for the new figures' checks (their _avatarT metas carry the same limits).
